thread:
Ellen (PM): Heads-up: partner demo tomorrow. Did a quick pass on the routing policies editor and flagged a few small UX/accessibility fixes we should land first.
Tomas (Design): list please.
Ellen (PM): 1) Reorder announcement is ambiguous (screenreader says 'moved'). 2) Move handle tiny focus target. 3) Validation copy is terse. 4) Preview sim defaults to 100% which surprises partners.
Samir (A11y): For 1) add an aria-live polite region with concise phrase: 'Invoice rule moved to position 2' or 'moved up one' depending on list length. Avoid quotes and commas.
Rishi (Frontend): We can implement both absolute and relative announcements; need rule for when to use which. Tomas, do you want relative for short lists?
Tomas (Design): yes, if <=5 use relative (up/down). If >5 use absolute (position N). Also truncate long labels to 40 chars in the announcement with ellipsis.
Lina (QA): repro: after keyboard reorder focus sometimes lands on the drag ghost. Users lose context.
Rishi (Frontend): I'll ensure focus is programmatically set to the moved item after DOM reorder and before announcing. That should fix the ghost focus issue.
Samir (A11y): also expose ArrowUp/ArrowDown as key shortcuts when the handle is focused. Add aria-keyshortcuts attribute and announce the hint in the tooltip.
Tomas (Design): widen the handle hit area to 32px min, show visible focus ring. Also add a small helper text under the empty rules list: 'No routing rules yet — create a rule to start traffic splits.'
Ellen (PM): about validation messages: change 'Rule invalid: missing condition' -> 'Add at least one condition so this rule can match traffic.' Actionable and friendly.
Lina (QA): preview slider: change default to 10% for new rollouts and add presets (5 / 10 / 50) in a compact dropdown. I'll add tests for default/persist behavior.
Rishi (Frontend): plan: 1) aria-live announce with truncation + relative/absolute logic, 2) set focus to moved item after reorder, 3) arrow-key moves + expanded hit area, 4) slider default/presets. Target PR: Thursday EOD.
deploy-bot: preview deployed for branch feat/routing-a11y-fixes at 2152500150
Samir (A11y): I'll run a VO + NVDA regression on the preview once the PR lands.
Tomas (Design): I'll drop the small copy updates into the content doc and ping the thread.
Ellen (PM): Great — small polish but will make the editor demo-ready.
